rules.title: Hardcoded API key in Python
rules.description: Detects hardcoded API keys, tokens, and credentials in Python source files
rules.remediation_guidance: Use environment variables or a secrets management system instead

rules.title: SQL injection vulnerability
rules.description: Detects potential SQL injection due to unsanitized user input in queries
rules.remediation_guidance: Use parameterized queries or ORM

rules.title: Weak password policy
rules.description: Detects weak password validation or lack of complexity requirements
rules.remediation_guidance: Enforce strong password policies with length, complexity, and character requirements

rules.title: Missing input validation
rules.description: Detects functions that accept user input without proper validation

rules.title: Database credentials in code
rules.description: Detects hardcoded database passwords in PHP files

rules.title: PHP SQL injection
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in PHP due to string concatenation

rules.title: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
rules.description: Detects echoing user input without HTML escaping

rules.title: API key in JavaScript
rules.description: Detects hardcoded API keys in JavaScript files

rules.title: DOM-based XSS
rules.description: Detects unsafe DOM manipulation that could lead to XSS

rules.title: Missing JSON.parse validation
rules.description: Detects JSON.parse without try-catch error handling

rules.title: JDBC connection string with credentials
rules.description: Detects hardcoded database connection strings with credentials

rules.title: Java SQL injection
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in Java code

rules.title: Weak cryptography
rules.description: Detects use of weak cryptographic algorithms

rules.title: .NET connection string with credentials
rules.description: Detects hardcoded SQL Server connection strings containing a Password= or pwd= literal in C# or config files
rules.remediation_guidance: Use a secrets manager or environment variable; never embed credentials in source

rules.title: Hardcoded credentials in .NET
rules.description: Detects hardcoded password or secret literal assignments in C# source
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace hardcoded credentials with environment variables or a secrets manager

rules.title: Raw SQL execution with variable input in .NET
rules.description: Detects ExecuteSqlRaw or FromSqlRaw called with a concatenated or interpolated string in C# — susceptible to SQL injection
rules.remediation_guidance: Use parameterized queries or EF Core LINQ; never concatenate user input into raw SQL

rules.title: SQL string interpolation in .NET
rules.description: Detects interpolated string literals ($"...") used inside SQL query strings in C#
rules.remediation_guidance: Use parameterized queries; never interpolate variables directly into SQL

rules.title: JWT lifetime validation disabled in .NET
rules.description: Detects ValidateLifetime = false in TokenValidationParameters — allows expired tokens to authenticate in C#/.NET services
rules.remediation_guidance: Keep ValidateLifetime = true and set a short ClockSkew

rules.title: Permissive CORS with credentials in .NET
rules.description: Detects AllowAnyOrigin() in an ASP.NET Core CORS policy — combining this with AllowCredentials() violates the CORS spec
rules.remediation_guidance: Use WithOrigins() to restrict to known domains; never combine AllowAnyOrigin with AllowCredentials

rules.title: Developer exception page without environment guard in .NET
rules.description: Detects app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage() outside of an IsDevelopment() guard — exposes stack traces in production
rules.remediation_guidance: Wrap UseDeveloperExceptionPage in if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment()) { ... }

rules.title: Missing antiforgery token on POST endpoint in .NET
rules.description: Detects [HttpPost] action methods lacking [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] in ASP.NET Core MVC controllers — leaves the endpoint open to CSRF
rules.remediation_guidance: Add [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] to all state-changing POST actions or use AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken globally

rules.title: Secrets in Dockerfile
rules.description: Detects a hardcoded secret assigned to an ENV/ARG variable in a Dockerfile (excludes build-arg references and ${...} interpolation)

rules.title: Running as root in Docker
rules.description: Detects containers without explicit non-root USER directive

rules.title: Sensitive port exposed in Dockerfile
rules.description: Detects EXPOSE of well-known sensitive service ports (SSH 22, Telnet 23, MySQL 3306, PostgreSQL 5432, MongoDB 27017, Redis 6379, Oracle 1521)
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not expose database or admin ports from application containers; use internal Docker networks instead

rules.title: ADD instruction instead of COPY in Dockerfile
rules.description: Detects use of ADD instead of COPY — ADD can silently fetch remote URLs and auto-extract archives, introducing supply-chain risk
rules.remediation_guidance: Use COPY for local files; only use ADD when you explicitly need URL fetch or archive extraction, and pin the URL with a checksum

rules.title: Mutable or latest base image tag in Dockerfile
rules.description: Detects FROM directives using :latest tag or no tag — mutable tags make builds non-reproducible and can silently pull a compromised upstream image
rules.remediation_guidance: Pin base images to a specific digest (e.g. python:3.12.3-slim@sha256:...) for reproducible builds

rules.description: Detects unsafe deserialization that could enable RCE

rules.title: WordPress AJAX handler missing nonce/capability check
rules.description: Detects WordPress (PHP) AJAX handlers registered via add_action('wp_ajax_*') whose callback lacks a nonce verification or capability check, allowing unauthorized actions
rules.remediation_guidance: Verify a nonce with check_ajax_referer()/wp_verify_nonce() and authorize the caller with current_user_can() at the start of every wp_ajax handler

rules.title: PHP unsafe deserialization of user input
rules.description: Detects PHP unserialize() called on request data, which can lead to object injection and remote code execution
rules.remediation_guidance: Avoid unserialize() on untrusted input; use json_decode() or pass allowed_classes=false

rules.title: PHP use of eval()
rules.description: Detects PHP eval() usage, which executes arbitrary code and is a common remote code execution sink
rules.remediation_guidance: Remove eval(); replace with explicit, safe logic and never execute dynamically built code

rules.title: PHP file inclusion from user input (LFI/path traversal)
rules.description: Detects PHP include/require statements built from request superglobals, enabling local file inclusion and path traversal
rules.remediation_guidance: Never include paths derived from user input; use an allowlist of known files

rules.title: GitHub Actions unsafe pull_request_target trigger
rules.description: Detects the CI/CD pull_request_target trigger, which runs with repository write token and secrets in the context of an untrusted fork PR
rules.remediation_guidance: Avoid pull_request_target for untrusted PRs; if required, never check out or execute PR head code and scope permissions to read-only

rules.title: GitHub Actions overly broad token permissions
rules.description: Detects CI/CD workflows granting write-all token permissions instead of least privilege
rules.remediation_guidance: Set least-privilege permissions (default read-only) and grant only the specific scopes a job needs

rules.title: Unpinned GitHub Actions dependency
rules.description: Detects CI/CD actions referenced by mutable tag or branch instead of a pinned full-length commit SHA, enabling supply-chain tampering
rules.remediation_guidance: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA, e.g. uses: owner/repo@<sha>

rules.title: GitHub Actions script injection via untrusted input
rules.description: Detects CI/CD shell interpolation of attacker-controllable github.event data directly into a run step, enabling command injection
rules.remediation_guidance: Never interpolate github.event.* into run scripts; pass via an env var and quote it, or use an action input

rules.title: CI/CD secret written to logs
rules.description: Detects CI/CD steps echoing a GitHub Actions secret to stdout, which can leak it into build logs
rules.remediation_guidance: Never echo secrets; rely on masked env injection and avoid printing secret values

rules.title: Hardcoded secret in CI/CD pipeline
rules.description: Detects a hardcoded credential or key literal committed into a CI/CD pipeline file instead of being referenced from a secrets store
rules.remediation_guidance: Never hardcode secrets in pipeline files; reference them from the CI secrets store (e.g. ${{ secrets.NAME }}) and rotate any exposed value

rules.title: Python unsafe deserialization
rules.description: Python: detects unsafe deserialization via pickle.loads or yaml.load without SafeLoader, enabling arbitrary code execution
rules.remediation_guidance: Avoid pickle on untrusted data; use yaml.safe_load() or json instead

rules.title: Python OS command injection
rules.description: Python: detects command execution via subprocess with shell=True or os.system, a command-injection sink
rules.remediation_guidance: Pass argument lists without shell=True; never build shell strings from user input

rules.title: Python use of eval/exec
rules.description: Python: detects eval() or exec() which execute arbitrary code and are common RCE sinks
rules.remediation_guidance: Remove eval/exec; use explicit parsing (ast.literal_eval) or safe dispatch

rules.title: Python debug mode enabled
rules.description: Python: detects Flask/Django debug mode enabled, which exposes the interactive debugger and stack traces in production
rules.remediation_guidance: Disable debug in production; drive it from an environment variable defaulting to False

rules.title: Python permissive CORS
rules.description: Python: detects FastAPI/Flask CORS configured to allow all origins, exposing authenticated APIs to any site
rules.remediation_guidance: Restrict allow_origins to an explicit allowlist of trusted origins

rules.title: Python path traversal via request input
rules.description: Python: detects file open() built directly from request input, enabling path traversal / arbitrary file read
rules.remediation_guidance: Validate and canonicalize paths against an allowlisted base directory before opening

rules.title: JavaScript OS command execution
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects child_process.exec/execSync, a command-injection sink when fed untrusted input
rules.remediation_guidance: Use execFile/spawn with an argument array and never interpolate user input into a shell string

rules.title: JavaScript SSRF via user-controlled request
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects axios/fetch called with request-derived input, enabling server-side request forgery
rules.remediation_guidance: Validate outbound URLs against an allowlist; reject internal/metadata hosts

rules.title: JavaScript use of eval
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects eval(), which executes arbitrary code and is a common injection sink
rules.remediation_guidance: Remove eval; use JSON.parse or explicit logic instead

rules.title: JavaScript prototype pollution sink
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects direct __proto__ assignment, a prototype-pollution sink that can corrupt object behavior
rules.remediation_guidance: Avoid writing to __proto__; use Map or Object.create(null) and validate keys

rules.title: JavaScript token stored in localStorage
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects auth tokens/secrets written to localStorage, which is readable by any XSS payload
rules.remediation_guidance: Store session tokens in HttpOnly, Secure cookies rather than localStorage

rules.title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.description: JavaScript/TypeScript: detects React dangerouslySetInnerHTML, an XSS sink when fed unsanitized input
rules.remediation_guidance: Avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML; if unavoidable, sanitize with a vetted library (e.g. DOMPurify)

rules.title: Instruction hierarchy override in external content
rules.description: Detects text attempting to replace or override system, developer, or earlier agent instructions
rules.remediation_guidance: Treat the matching content as untrusted data and require human review before operational use

rules.title: Memory poisoning request in external content
rules.description: Detects external content asking an agent to persist instructions or claims in memory
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not write external instructions or claims to persistent memory without explicit review

rules.title: Authority marker or encoded instruction indicator
rules.description: Detects fake system markers or declared encoded payloads in external content
rules.remediation_guidance: Preserve the content as data and inspect encoded material only in a bounded, non-executing analysis path

rules.title: Package lifecycle execution in external manifest
rules.description: Detects package lifecycle scripts that may execute during installation
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not install untrusted dependencies; review lifecycle scripts in an isolated workflow

rules.title: Broad MCP capability declaration
rules.description: Detects MCP manifests declaring unrestricted filesystem or shell permissions
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace broad capabilities with least-privilege, explicitly allowlisted operations

rules.title: Unverified MCP manifest
rules.description: Detects an MCP manifest that explicitly identifies its tool manifest as unverified
rules.remediation_guidance: Verify the manifest against a pinned source and expected tool contract before registration
